audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A light, upbeat pop BGM begins. The female narrator speaks with a high-pitched, enthusiastic tone. Faint sounds of fabric rustling occur. (2) A sharp 'impact' sound effect triggers as the man speaks a short, confused phrase. (3) BGM continues steadily as the female narrates; the tempo is moderate. (4) A rapid 'whoosh' transition SFX plays. The male voice becomes louder and more assertive. (5) A loud, comedic 'shout' from the man is heard, followed by a 'boing' cartoon sound effect. (6) Sound of a fitting room door sliding shut. The female voice has a slight reverb as she speaks in a contained space. (7) A laughter track SFX plays as the BGM swells. (8) A 'glitch' static SFX accompanies a fast transition. (9) The music shifts to a high-energy dance track with a heavy kick drum and synthesized brass. Crowds cheering SFX are layered in. (10) A percussive 'ding' sound effect highlights a joke. The female voice speaks at a very fast pace. (11) A dramatic cinematic 'hit' SFX plays as the male voice flexes. (12) Bright, commercial pop music takes over. The female voice delivers a rhythmic promotional speech. Sounds of thick plastic shopping bags crinkling are audible and frequent.
